paragraphs: Bamboo Health sells software that joins behavioral and physical health data into a longitudinal patient record and places it inside the systems clinicians already work in. Its audiences include community and behavioral health providers and federally qualified health centers. Accountable care organizations and other provider groups are addressed separately.

Alerts are driven by admission, discharge and transfer feeds, and care navigation can be started from inside an electronic health record. For people with substance use disorder, prescription drug monitoring program data and alerts are used to flag risk and guide patients toward care. Care navigators also review rosters by hand to find high utilizers whose behavioral health needs have gone unmet. Behavioral health referrals and crisis resource availability sit alongside that history in one place.

The company took its present form in 2021, when Appriss Health acquired PatientPing and rebranded. It claims a footprint across 52 states and territories. Encounters on its network are put at 3 billion a year. Published material points to work with the State of Delaware on crisis care and behavioral health coordination.

quote.text: Bamboo Health now delivers powerful patient clarity during pivotal moments through Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions.
